entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane where a revolt takes place against the Consulate.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city of Kaladesh, large portions of which the Renegades have seized.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: The leader of the Renegades' revolution against the Consulate.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: A revolt aligned with aether-pirates, essence-drainers and weaponsmiths, whose symbol is the leaking spire.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The ruling authority of Ghirapur that cracks down on the revolt.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The band of planeswalkers who support the Renegades while hunting Tezzeret.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who supports the Renegades.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: The nefarious planeswalker the Gatewatch seeks.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: A Consulate figure who taunts Chandra Nalaar to lure her from the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker of the Gatewatch whom Baral taunts.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who fights Tezzeret in the final battle at the bridge.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon whose upcoming role is foreshadowed.

events.summary: Led by Pia Nalaar, the Renegades revolt and seize large parts of Ghirapur to overthrow the Consulate.
events.quote: the Renegades have seized control of large portions of Ghirapur

events.summary: The Consulate responds with security, seizures of unregistered inventions, aether monitoring and a curfew.
events.quote: The Consulate responds with increased security and surveillance

events.summary: The Gatewatch and Ajani support the Renegades while searching for Tezzeret.
events.quote: The Gatewatch and Ajani Goldmane support the renegades

events.summary: Baral taunts Chandra Nalaar to lure her away from the rest of the Gatewatch.
events.quote: Disallow depicts Baral's taunting of Chandra Nalaar in an attempt to lure her away from the rest of the Gatewatch.

events.summary: Tezzeret and Liliana Vess fight their final battle at the bridge.
events.quote: Battle at the Bridge depicts the final battle between Tezzeret and Liliana Vess .
